CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_projects ( project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_bindings ( backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_data_projects(project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, local_directory TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (backend_id, project_id), UNIQUE (backend_id, local_directory) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_requirements ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_data_projects(project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_reference TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, requirement_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_requirement_revisions ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_reference TEXT, note TEXT, task_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, requirement_id, revision), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, requirement_id) REFERENCES project_data_requirements(project_id, requirement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_decisions ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, decision_id TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, effective INTEGER NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_reference TEXT, at_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, requirement_id, decision_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, requirement_id) REFERENCES project_data_requirements(project_id, requirement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_references ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, reference_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, requirement_id, reference_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, requirement_id) REFERENCES project_data_requirements(project_id, requirement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_requirements_project ON project_data_requirements(project_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_revisions_project ON project_data_requirement_revisions(project_id, requirement_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_board_entries ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, board_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, entry_kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, publish_request_id TEXT NOT NULL, assignment_kind TEXT, assignee_id TEXT, handler_backend_id TEXT, handler_project_id TEXT, handler_task_id TEXT, assigned_at TEXT, delivery_merge_id TEXT, delivery_commit TEXT, delivery_merged_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, board_id), UNIQUE (project_id, requirement_id), UNIQUE (project_id, publish_request_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, requirement_id) REFERENCES project_data_requirements(project_id, requirement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_board_events ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, board_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, handler_backend_id TEXT, handler_project_id TEXT, handler_task_id TEXT, from_state TEXT, to_state TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, board_id, event_id), UNIQUE (project_id, request_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, board_id) REFERENCES project_data_board_entries(project_id, board_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_board_entries_project ON project_data_board_entries(project_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_board_events_board ON project_data_board_events(project_id, board_id, revision)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_main_sessions ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project_data_projects(project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, entry_kind TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, current_requirement_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, session_id), UNIQUE (backend_id, project_id, task_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_main_session_runs ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, session_id, run_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, session_id) REFERENCES project_data_main_sessions(project_id, session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_main_sessions_project ON project_data_main_sessions(project_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_main_session_runs_task ON project_data_main_session_runs(task_id, run_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_developments ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, goal TEXT NOT NULL, completion_criteria TEXT NOT NULL, route TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, baseline_branch TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_commit TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, task_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, development_id), UNIQUE (project_id, requirement_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, requirement_id) REFERENCES project_data_requirements(project_id, requirement_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_workspaces ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, directory TEXT NOT NULL, branch TEXT NOT NULL, base_commit TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, development_id, backend_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_merge_configs ( project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES project_data_projects(project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, repository TEXT NOT NULL, target_branch TEXT NOT NULL, execution_backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_developments_project ON project_data_developments(project_id, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_review_plans ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, basis TEXT NOT NULL, checks TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_commit TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_tree TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_branch TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_workspace TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, development_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_tickets ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, tickets TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, development_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_reviews ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, candidate_commit TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_tree TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_branch TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_workspace TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT, previous_review_id TEXT, previous_candidate_commit TEXT, changed_paths TEXT NOT NULL, reviewer TEXT, findings TEXT NOT NULL, reworks TEXT NOT NULL, verdict TEXT, drift TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, review_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_reviews_project ON project_data_development_reviews(project_id, development_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_merges ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, merge_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, requested_by TEXT NOT NULL, execution_backend_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_branch TEXT NOT NULL, candidate TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_commit TEXT NOT NULL, acceptance TEXT NOT NULL, checks TEXT NOT NULL, reasons TEXT NOT NULL, combined_base TEXT, expected_target TEXT, merge_commit TEXT, owner_started_at TEXT, detail TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, merge_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_merges_applying ON project_data_development_merges(project_id) WHERE state = 'applying'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_merges_candidate ON project_data_development_merges(project_id, development_id, candidate_commit) WHERE state IN ('waiting', 'applying', 'merged')
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_development_merges_project ON project_data_development_merges(project_id, development_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_data_deliveries ( project_id TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_id TEXT NOT NULL, development_id TEXT NOT NULL, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL, merge_id TEXT NOT NULL, candidate_commit TEXT NOT NULL, merged_commit TEXT NOT NULL, target_branch TEXT NOT NULL, merged_at TEXT NOT NULL, board_id TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, error TEXT, synced_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (project_id, delivery_id), UNIQUE (project_id, merge_id), FOREIGN KEY (project_id, development_id) REFERENCES project_data_developments(project_id, development_id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS project_data_deliveries_project ON project_data_deliveries(project_id, development_id, created_at)
